text:
ashok: FYI pushed RBAC role refactor to staging. viewer/editor/admin split + new permission flags. Noticed one thing: some users with Viewer lost ability to open Console > Keys (KMS) UI. Not urgent but blocking rollout.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of rbac-refactor v2 -> staging at 1801234590 :rocket:

maria: I can repro — Viewer can't open /console/keys, gets 403 modal. Screenshot: https://redwood.slack/screenshot/abc123

kevin: Is that the same as the old billing gating bug from last quarter? If so maybe route mismatch.

zoe: looking at policy logs — audit shows allow on `kms.read` but UI gate checks `console.kms.view` (new name). migration script should have mapped old -> new. possible migration gap.

ashok: uh — migration run returned success but maybe dry-run on prod. I ran `./scripts/rbac/migrate --apply` yesterday though.

lucy: Can we quickly patch UI to fallback to old perm names until migration fixed? Quick fix in frontend: `permissions.includes('console.kms.view') || permissions.includes('kms.read')`

kevin: Agree. But need audit trail. Security wants to avoid silent fallback. @security-bot can we log an event when fallback used?

security-bot: security-bot: created ticket SEC-421: 'RBAC fallback usage telemetry' — will add audit event + alert if >1% users hit fallback in 24h.

maria: Also KMS audit logs show a few failed decrypt attempts tied to this group — could be unrelated but worth triage.

ashok: Rolling a frontend hotfix to staging now, will include telemetry. patch branch: `hotfix/rbac-ui-fallback-1801`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy started for hotfix/rbac-ui-fallback-1801 by ashok at 1801234680

zoe: For migration: snippet of the mapping we used: ```json
{"kms.read":"console.kms.view","kms.manage":"console.kms.admin"}
``` Looks right, but maybe script skipped group mappings.

lucy: I'll run the migration with `--verify` on staging and capture delta.

ashok: If migration logic skipped due to missing flag, we should revert new role gating on prod immediately until it's clean. But let's wait for staging verify first.

maria: If we end up reverting, include KMS audit window in rollback notes — compliance will want logs + who accessed keys.

kevin: Also flag vuln triage: this mismatch could have been used to escalate privileges? Need short threat model run. @security-bot add to SEC triage.

security-bot: security-bot: added to triage board with P1 if evidence of privilege escalation. Link: https://redwood.inc/triage/SEC-421

ashok: Hotfix passed staging tests. Rolling to prod canary in 10m. I will leave audit hooks enabled.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: prod canary started for hotfix/rbac-ui-fallback-1801 at 1801235040

maria: Confirming users can now see Keys UI in canary group. No 403s. Will monitor.

zoe: After canary stabilizes, schedule full migration re-run with `--force-map-groups` and export delta to S3: `s3://redwood-rbac/migrations/1801234567-diff.json`

ashok: Thanks everyone. I'll write a short postmortem and add migration checklist: pre-run verify, group mapping check, telemetry flags.

kevin: :thumbsup: please link me the PM and compliance notes.
